_about: The restaurant's star rating (see Rating). It starts at 1 star and only goes up. Each star in "stars" needs all four areas: service (average satisfaction over the last service_days days open, 0 to 1), menu (dishes and drinks unlocked), community (friendship with the regulars, plus guest_points for each different named townsfolk served) and decor (Decor.score; 0 = not needed). When they're all met, the critic comes to that day's service. Happy or better (pass_satisfaction) earns the star at closing; if not, they come back retry_days later, with no loss.
_critic: Who visits. townsfolk: the id of a file in data/townsfolk/ to use as the critic (they then say that file's lines). Left empty, an unnamed critic comes with the name and species here and says the generic townsfolk lines. PLACEHOLDER wording below, along with award_lines.

critic.name: Food Critic
critic.arrives: A food critic just walked in! Make this one count.
critic.passed: The critic made a note and smiled.
critic.not_yet: The critic closed their notebook. They'll be back another day.

award_lines: (A letter slides under the door. It's from the food critic.)
ready_hint: Everything's ready for the next star. The critic could come in any day now.
top_hint: Five stars! There's nothing left to earn.
